t: A high school unit that swaps into Exploring Computer Science to teach AI.
steps: Find the ECS Alternate Unit on AI on the Exploring Computer Science site.
Download the curriculum PDF and the teacher PowerPoint.
Download the unplugged materials and videos.
Ask the ECS page or the author which NVIDIA hardware is needed.
Ask IT to help set up the hardware.
Try the build and train steps yourself first.
Plan the unit as a replacement for Unit 5 or Unit 6.
